WHERE size(ids) > 0

MATCH (:Company {ticker: 'INTC'})-[:FILED]->(f:Filing {form_type: '10-Q'})
WHERE f.fiscal_period IN ['FY2024-Q1', 'FY2025-Q1']
MATCH (n)-[:EVIDENCED_BY]->(c:Chunk)-[:PART_OF]->(f)
WHERE (n:Segment OR n:MarketPlatform OR n:Product) AND any(x IN [n.name] + coalesce(n.aliases, []) WHERE toLower(x) CONTAINS 'client' OR toLower(x) CONTAINS 'ccg' OR toLower(x) CONTAINS 'notebook' OR toLower(x) CONTAINS 'desktop')
WITH f, n, collect(c.chunk_id) AS ids
RETURN f.fiscal_period AS period_filing, n.name AS concept, null AS value, null AS unit, null AS period, ids AS chunk_ids
